title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Search Service module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-searchservice'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

hosting_mode.description: (Optional) Specifies the Hosting Mode, which allows for High Density partitions (that allow for up to 1000 indexes) should be supported. Possible values are highDensity or default. Defaults to default.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

partition_count.description: (Optional) Specifies the number of partitions which should be created. This field cannot be set when using a free or basic sku.

replica_count.description: (Optional) Specifies the number of Replica's which should be created for this Search Service. This field cannot be set when using a free sku

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

semantic_search_sku.description: (Optional) Specifies the Semantic Search SKU which should be used for this Search Service. Possible values include free and standard, The semantic_search_sku cannot be defined if your Search Services sku is set to free

sku.description: (Required) The SKU which should be used for this Search Service. Possible values include basic, free, standard, standard2, standard3, storage_optimized_l1 and storage_optimized_l2.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The Resource ID of the Azure search service.

name.description: The Name of the Azure search service.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Searchservice' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
